what: W1 external-baseline table REGENERATED model-coherently (all LLM arms on deepseek-v4-flash-free) before paper-number freeze
motivation: The W1 table mixed generator models: llm_unverified/stateful_llm ran on deepseek-v4-flash-free (pinned in .env during W1) while the grounded arms (rag_no_verifier, ragin_full_reference, Sep-22) ran on the pre-pin gateway default. Cross-model comparison inflated the grounded arms' technique scores. All grounded arms re-run 2026-09-27 under the current model.

rag_no_verifier_repro.note: NEW: grounded pipeline, verifier pass-through, deepseek

ragin_full.note: REGENERATED ragin_full row: verified loop, deepseek (was 0.8474 on the Sep-22 model)

ragin_hostfiction.note: host-fiction layer ON — paired score delta vs ragin_full: 0.0000 (all 218 rows identical)

historical_reference_sep22.note: kept for provenance; do NOT pair across the model boundary in the paper

verifier_contribution_same_model.note: ragin_full vs rag_no_verifier under the SAME model: quality held at 0.6176 vs 0.6176 while the verified loop served 0 unverified responses (the no-verifier arm served all 218 unverified, provenance-labeled GENERATED_UNVERIFIED)
verifier_contribution_same_model.mechanism_note: Paired per-row delta is EXACTLY 0 on all 218 rows: the verification gate is not in the generation prompt and the fiction seed is identical across arms, so each row's prompt is byte-identical and the generator returns the same draft in both arms; the verifier passes 213/218 outright and swaps 5 for the fail-safe template. This comparison therefore isolates the verifier's GATING effect (safety boundary) at quality parity, not generator variance. Quality differences across eras are attributable to the generator model (see historical_reference_sep22).

grounding_contribution_same_model.note: ragin_full vs llm_unverified, both deepseek: grounding adds composite

regenerated_claims.host_fiction_neutrality: paired delta 0.0000 over 218 rows (store ON vs OFF); drift protection 4/4 vs 1/4 in the cross-session bench
regenerated_claims.table_reading: Model-coherent ladder (all LLM arms deepseek-v4-flash-free): cowrie 0.0006 < stateful_llm 0.0704 < llm_unverified 0.5018 < ragin_full 0.6176 = rag_no_verifier 0.6176 < ragin_hostfiction 0.6176. Grounding adds +0.1158 composite over bare LLM; the deterministic verifier adds quality parity with zero unverified serves; the host-fiction layer adds cross-session drift protection at exactly zero quality cost. The W1-era 0.96/0.85 grounded numbers were a generator-model effect (stronger exact-match rubric compliance), not an architecture effect — the paper must state the generator model in the table.
